name: 4else Events – Event Teaser & Booking Connector
author: Beatrice | fourelse ag

sections.description:
4else Events – Event Teaser & Booking Connector connects your WordPress website with 4else.com.

Lightweight WordPress plugin for external events, QR tickets, registrations and course calendars.

Connect WordPress easily with the professional event management platform 4else.com.

Publish events, workshops, courses and registrations directly from your 4else workspace to your WordPress website.

Features include:

QR-code ticketing
QR ticket scanner and check-in
Optional online payment during booking
Automatic removal of expired events
Registration system for events, courses, workshops and surveys
Workshop and seminar booking
Participant management
External event calendar embed
Event registration forms
Course management
Ticket sales for events and workshops

This plugin is not a standalone event system for WordPress. It connects your website with 4else and displays your existing 4else event calendar on your WordPress website.

Visitors can click events and are then directed to the corresponding 4else event, ticket or registration page.

Paste your complete EvenTeas embed code from 4else and use the shortcode:

[fourelse_events]

4else.com can be used free of charge. Optional payment integration is available with moderate transaction fees.

External services

This plugin connects to the external service 4else, provided by fourelse ag.

When a page containing the shortcode [fourelse_events] is loaded, the stored EvenTeas embed code loads a JavaScript file from:

https://www.4else.com

This script displays the event calendar connected to your individual 4else EvenTeas code. Visitors can click displayed events and are then directed to the corresponding 4else event or registration page.

A 4else account is required to use this plugin.

Service provider: fourelse ag
Service website: https://4else.events/
4else application: https://www.4else.com/
Privacy policy: https://4else.events/datenschutz/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file and activate it.
  2. Go to “4else Events” in the WordPress admin area.
  3. Paste your complete EvenTeas code from 4else.
  4. Add the shortcode [fourelse_events] to a page, post, shortcode block or Divi module.
sections.faq:
Do I need a 4else account?

Yes. The plugin connects WordPress with your existing 4else event calendar.

Can I use the plugin with Divi?

Yes. Add the shortcode [fourelse_events] to a Divi text module, code module or shortcode-capable area.

Does the plugin handle payments?

No. Payments, registrations and ticketing are handled in 4else. This plugin displays the 4else event calendar in WordPress and links visitors to the corresponding 4else event pages.
